title: Connecting Speech to Words through Images
abstract: arXiv:2606.16807v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: How can we learn the mapping between written words and their spoken counterparts in the absence of explicit textual supervision? We present a visually grounded method for building a vocabulary of spoken words using only images and their spoken descriptions. First, image captioning systems are used to build a vocabulary of written words representing salient visual concepts in the images. For each word, we then find utterances whose image captions contain that word. Then we use an unsupervised word discovery technique to align these utterances to locate instances of the target word. The result is spoken word segments that are linked to written words -- all accomplished without any text supervision. In spoken word retrieval and keyword spotting experiments, the proposed approach outperforms a strong neural baseline while being more interpretable. translated_title: 通过图像将语音与文字相连
translated_abstract: 在缺乏显式文本监督的情况下，我们如何学习书面词与其口语对应形式之间的映射？我们提出了一种视觉接地的方法，仅使用图像及其口语描述来构建口语词汇库。首先，利用图像描述生成系统构建一个代表图像中显著视觉概念的书面词汇库；对于每个词，我们找出其图像描述中包含该词的语音话语；然后使用一种无监督的词发现技术对这些话语进行对齐，以定位目标词的实例。最终得到与书面词相关联的口语词片段——这一切都无需任何文本监督。在口语词检索和关键词检出实验中，所提出的方法优于强大的神经基线，同时更具可解释性。这些结果证明了该方法在英语中的可行性，并为未来研究提供了方向。
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需任何文本监督的视觉接地方法，仅利用图像及其口语描述构建口语词片段与书面词的对应关系，在口语词检索和关键词检出任务上超越强神经基线且更具可解释性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a visually grounded method that requires no text supervision, building mappings between spoken word segments and written words using only images and their spoken descriptions, outperforming strong neural baselines in spoken word retrieval and keyword spotting while being more interpretable.
